name: I Chase You and Hunt You Down For Sport
source:
All you wanted to do was to take a walk in the woods. Instead, your stroll is interrupted by a strange figure with… bunny ears?

[From [url=https://feral-mouse.itch.io/i-chase-you-and-hunt-you-down-for-sport]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你想做的就是在树林里散步。相反，你的散步被一个带着……兔子耳朵的奇怪人物打断了？

[来自[url=https://feral-mouse.itch.io/i-chase-you-and-hunt-you-down-for-sport]Itch.io[/url]]
